name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-mail-spy
description: Who receives staff/ops copies of spy and contact-owner mail. Kernel still sends SMTP. Disable to stop those copies.

cooldown.label: Spy cooldown
cooldown.description: Minimum delay between two spy mails of the same kind to the same person (for example 15m).
cooldown.sectionDescription: How hard spy copies may hit staff inboxes. Who receives each channel is the rules list.

sendVolumeDay.label: Spy send-volume day
sendVolumeDay.description: Day-of-month used when counting daily spy volume. Leave 30 unless you changed that cron convention.

disableCooldown.label: Disable spy cooldown
disableCooldown.description: Turn on only while testing locally. Leave off in production.

disableEmail.label: Disable spy email
disableEmail.description: Stops every spy copy without disabling the plugin. Use for a quiet maintenance window.

devEmailDir.label: Dev spy email dump dir
devEmailDir.description: Folder where spy mail is written in development instead of SMTP. Ignore on a live host.

rules.label: Rules
rules.description: Edited on the Rules tab. Each item is { "channel", "role" } or { "channel", "email" }, plus enabled. enabled false turns that channel off. Missing enabled means on. Customers (role user) are ignored.
